headline: Marban Hollow Shows Freshest Base Movement
war_summary: Marban Hollow supplies the freshest strategic-base movement in the latest edition, with its most recent event recorded at 10:01 UTC. Fifteen base events have been logged there in 24 hours, and the field remains divided three Warden to five Colonial while casualty and enlistment rates accelerate on both sides. No region has registered a base event in the latest two hours, however, leaving the immediate ledger momentarily still. Deadlands remains the principal contested theatre, split seven Warden to four Colonial, with 17 daily events and three in six hours; its Colonial casualty and enlistment rates have cooled, while Warden losses hold steady. The Fingers is also divided, three Warden to four Colonial, and shows sharply accelerating losses, though only three events were logged in the day. Callahan’s Passage and Weathered Expanse have no recent recorded captures but report the heaviest current fighting among Warden-held sectors, with both casualty streams accelerating. Stlican Shelf remains Warden-held after 13 daily events and continued high losses, while Drowned Vale and the other coastal fronts have gone comparatively quiet.
